safe_test_strategy: Use bounded harmless expressions through the existing template injection engine.
expected_behavior: Input must not be evaluated as a server-side template expression.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Repeatable expression evaluation with negative controls, without command execution.
